name: Gino Tieri
headline: Area Vice President at Oracle NetSuite
about:
Business development and marketing executive successful at building and leading winning teams. A proven performer that drives sales results, builds and maintains key client relationships, creates sales processes and marketing programs to support the development of new business. A creative executive leader with strong problem solving skills, strategic thought leadership, and exceptional business acumen. Ability to develop relationships at senior levels and provide sound and inspirational leadership to sales and marketing teams that drive increased revenue and profitable business. A versatile seasoned leader able to help organizations reach their customers directly or through industry channels.

DIFFERENTIATORS:
 
Business Development and “Go-To-Market” Innovator – Able to look at the current state and design, implement, and execute creative and meaningful plans resulting in growth for organizations both organically and through new business acquisition.

Strategic & Inspirational Team Leader – Proven ability to develop and implement strategies that engage teams under my direction as well as those that support my teams. A leader that believes inspiring those around him will lead to great success for both the organization as well as the individuals involved, be them internal or external.

Proven Business-Builder – Demonstrated success in leading businesses that achieve sustainable and meaningful growth.

Experienced Change Agent – Led organizations successfully through difficult team transformations leading to growth by making the tough decisions in the interest of both the organization and the individuals effected.

Industry Diversification - A diverse set of experience across technology, marketing, and financial services which has served me well in bringing ideas forward into business' that have stalled by doing to the same thing over and over again. A fresh set of eyes and perspective provided to companies I have worked for that challenge the status quo.
… more

experiences.description: Responsible for the sales efforts of the Eastern regions 19 SaaS ERP teams.  Focused on strategic direction of the region and growing the footprint of Oracle NetSuite customers in the SMB space.

Responsible for the sales efforts of three regional SaaS ERP teams.  Working with the management and sales reps to address client SaaS needs for ERP that automate business processes with respect to accounting, procurement, expenses mgmt, inventory mgmt/control, etc..  Reducing time and expense while improving their bottom line.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Vice President - Sales & Marketing is responsible for leading all  efforts to grow the mortgage origination volume specific to alternative residential lending.  Main focus is on development of key sales and marketing programs targeted at the mortgage broker channel to increase Equity's mortgage portfolio that results in increased profits and shareholder value.

Reporting to the President, the National VIce President - Broker Channel Sales is accountable for providing leadership and direction to a team of regional sales leaders and their associated teams across Canada.  The mandate is to build strategic sales and marketing plans that will set the stage for extensive growth in the mortgage broker community.
Responsible for oversight of all sales and sales operations across the US and Canada.  Managed a team of 8 in field reps across the United States.
